purpose: Measure the original movie platform color conversion without replacing its algorithm or playback timing

island.encoding: ldr pc,[pc,#-4]; absolute host bridge address

patches.name: rgb_enter
patches.abi: Replay LDR lr,[r0,#0x40] into saved guest LR; r0=this, r1=destination, r2/r3=source arguments, this+0x3c/+0x40=width/height; retain the original function stack

patches.name: rgb_leave
patches.abi: Replay STR r0,[r1] after checking current guest write permission; preserve r0 and resume the original epilogue

patches.name: nv12_enter
patches.abi: Replay STR r1,[original guest sp,#12] after checking write permission; r0=this, r1=destination, r2/r3=source arguments, this+0x3c/+0x40=width/height; retain the original function stack

patches.name: nv12_leave
patches.abi: Replay STR r0,[r9] after checking current guest write permission; preserve r0 and resume the original epilogue

timing.scope: wall time between mid-function entry and exit probes; includes scheduling and bridge overhead; not CPU-only time or displayed FPS
timing.state: one active conversion per executor: main plus 63 guest worker slots
timing.no_samples: unavailable; never report zero conversion cost from a function that was not observed

validation: Before any probe write, require the locked module SHA256/build ID, both complete original function hashes, and all four original ARM words; reject mismatches before execution
